scripts.install: for dir in */; do (cd "$dir" && npm install) || exit 1; done
scripts.build: if [ -n "$CI" ]; then check=check:only; else check=check; fi; order=$(node ../scripts/build-packages.js --order */) && for dir in $order; do (cd "$dir" && npm run "$check" --if-present && npm run build --if-present && npm test --if-present) || exit 1; done
